build_swin_transformer_backbone: build a SwinTransformer backbone with configurable depths, num_heads, window_size, and embed_dim for semantic segmentation
create_d2swin_transformer: create a D2SwinTransformer registered in Detectron2 BACKBONE_REGISTRY using config MODEL.SWIN fields
build_window_attention: build a WindowAttention module with relative position bias for shifted window multi-head self-attention
create_swin_transformer_block: create a SwinTransformerBlock with window partitioning, cyclic shift, and FFN for hierarchical feature extraction
build_patch_merging: build a PatchMerging layer that reduces spatial resolution by half and doubles channel dimension
